channel.title: Wire — Ruby
channel.description: Ruby from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Cut Your GitHub Actions Times and Costs in Half
item.description: More AI code means more commits and more CI. Run GitHub Actions 2x faster at half the cost with a one-line change. Redeem code START50 for $50 in free credits. (2 sources: nodeweekly, rubyweekly)

item.title: Package managers have an integrity problem
item.description: I tested 25 of the most popular package managers to check whether they detect a compromised package repository injecting malicious code into legitimate packages. Only two verified the integrity of every package they downloaded. (2 sources: lobsters, rubyweekly)

item.title: The Best Way to Use Icons in Web UIs
item.description: What if I told you, you could use CSS to insert and tweak icons without touching any HTML? And that it could be more flexible and maintainable than what you’ve been using? (2 sources: frontendfocus, rubyweekly)

item.title: Living in the Weimar era of Ruby
item.description: Much has been said about the DHH keynote that he gave at RailsWorld. To me, it was the voice of a person in an existential crisis, but also a very jaded one. (2 sources: lobsters, rubyweekly)

item.title: Ruby 4.1 Preview 1 Released
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of Ruby 4.1.0-preview1.Ruby 4.1 introduces Ractor local GC, Windows support of YJIT, autoload_relative,and adds many i... (1 source: rubyweekly)

item.title: ZJIT is Now as Fast as YJIT
item.description: After some infrastructure deployment shenanigans, we deployed some regions of storefront renderer (SFR) running on ZJIT. We have seen some promising numbers. (1 source: rubyweekly)
